label: Читая
description: A 10-sentence card for читая, the imperfective gerund of читать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Front position. Читая is built from the present stem of читать (чита-ют) plus -я. The gerund clause stands in front and names what she did at the same time as smiling — she read while she smiled.

missions.phrase: Он сидел в кресле, читая газету.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: End position. Here читая closes the sentence and describes a second action running alongside the main verb сидел. Both actions belong to the same subject, он, and happen simultaneously.

missions.phrase: Читая медленно, ты лучше понимаешь текст.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Present tense. The main clause is in the present (понимаешь), and читая marks the simultaneous condition: while you read slowly, you understand better. The gerund never changes form for tense.

missions.phrase: Читая эту книгу, я многое узнаю.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Same-subject rule. The doer of читая must be the doer of the main verb: I read and I learn. The gerund cannot take its own separate subject, which is its core grammatical constraint.

Strategic focus: Plural subject unchanged. Even with the plural subject студенты, the form stays читая — gerunds are indeclinable and take no number ending, unlike a participle, which would agree as читающие.

missions.phrase: Читая вслух, дети учат новые слова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Habitual present. The main verb учат is a general present, and читая gives the accompanying manner: reading aloud, the children learn. One fixed gerund form serves every subject and tense.

missions.phrase: Читая письмо матери, он вспомнил детство.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past main clause. The finite verb вспомнил is past, yet читая marks the action as concurrent with it: while reading, he remembered. Simultaneity, not sequence, is what the imperfective gerund conveys.

missions.phrase: Завтра, читая доклад, я буду волноваться.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future main clause. The main clause looks ahead (буду волноваться), but читая itself stays unchanged — the gerund has no future form. The reading and the worrying will happen together.

missions.phrase: Читая в темноте, ты портишь зрение.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Indeclinable form. Whether the subject is masculine, feminine or plural, читая keeps one shape. Compare the participle читающий, which would inflect for gender, number and case — the gerund never does.

Strategic focus: Two parallel actions. Бабушка is the single shared subject of both дремала and читая, the two actions overlapping in time. The gerund compresses while she read into one indeclinable word.
